_comment: PubMed esearch log for curated edges that had no hand-reviewed grade. accepted is false: several queries matched tens or hundreds of thousands of papers (proteins AND energy metabolism returned 354369 hits). Volume thresholds would have labelled those Grade A. That is a query artefact, not evidence, so these rows do not enter the graph until a reviewer sets accepted to true on a row-level basis. PMIDs are the first esearch hits, not a curated bibliography.
